_rules: Autonomous loop (CLAUDE.md): take the 'active' item or the first 'not_started', build, verify, review, commit, then continue with the next without asking.
WIP = 1: exactly one item may be 'active'.
States: not_started -> active -> passing | blocked (blocked needs 'blocked_reason'; the loop then moves on).
Only a passing verification command (proven to fail when the feature is reverted) moves an item to passing; evidence = {commit, screens, notes}.
Order = build order. Foundation first, then auth, then handset compatibility (checkout and install depend on it).

features.behavior: Guest purchase resumes after login/register/Google
features.verification: flutter test test/features/checkout
features.blocked_reason: This FR persists {productId, discountCode} before sending a guest to login and resumes checkout afterward -- but there is no checkout flow to persist from or resume into yet (FR-301+ are all not_started; catalog FR-201+ that would let a guest pick a product is also not_started). Building the persistence provider in isolation now (like FR-007's pendingReferralProvider, built ahead of FR-101's register screen) was considered, but unlike FR-007 there is no real producer (a guest purchase attempt) or consumer (resumed checkout) to wire it to or test meaningfully yet, and redirecting to a not-yet-existing route would be unsafe with go_router. Revisit when FR-301 (checkout review screen) exists -- build the pending-purchase provider and this FR together then, same incremental pattern as FR-007/FR-105b.

features.behavior: Sign out clears token and cached user data

evidence.notes: AuthNotifier.logout() existed since FR-101; this round gave it dedicated coverage now that FR-107 makes it meaningful. 2 new tests pass: SecureStore is actually cleared (token + must_change_password), and a fresh ProviderContainer over the same storage (simulating relaunch) restores to signed-out.
